body: Does it work correctly if you launch it in the main godot folder not in `bin`? This is required and documented [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/architecture/unit_testing.html#running-tests), this should probably be made more clear though

When I tried to run the tests from the main Godot folder, I got the following output, shown below. I also took a screenshot of the pertinent documentation section, shown at bottom. It does show the current working directory as \bin when executing the "--test" command. Agreed this should be cleared up either way. I'm thinking maybe I should do a fresh build using only the dev mode specifier, such as "scons platform=windows dev_mode=yes". The documentation does say that tests would be automatically compiled with this command. This shouldn't matter, but I'll check and report back. C:\Users\...\source\repos\Godot>godot.windows.editor.x86_64.exe --test 'godot.windows.editor.x86_64.exe' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.
